messages.text: Lions forward Andrews dies suddenly ahead of match in France

metadata.summary: Lions player Hyron Andrews has died suddenly in France, where the team were preparing for a Champions Cup fixture.
metadata.content: Hyron Andrews: South African rugby side Lions confirm sudden death of player ahead of Champions Cup match in France against La Rochelle | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Hyron Andrews: South African rugby side Lions confirm sudden death of player ahead of Champions Cup match in France against La Rochelle Hyron Andrews died suddenly in France at the age of 31; the Lions say their Champions Cup game on Saturday against La Rochelle will go ahead in honour of the forward; Andrews previously played for English club Sale Sharks Friday 16 October 2026 15:25, UK Image: Hyron Andrews has died aged 31 Lions player Hyron Andrews has died suddenly in France, where the team were preparing for a Champions Cup fixture. Following French media reports earlier on Friday that a Lions player had passed away, the club released a statement in the afternoon that named Andrews. The 31-year-old South African second-row forward had spent the previous two years of his career playing for Sale Sharks in England before returning home this summer to join the Lions. The Lions said Saturday's match against La Rochelle will go ahead "in honour of Hyron". Twitter This content is provided by Twitter , which may be using cookies and other technologies. metadata.summary: Mikel Arteta says Arsenal will take a new team photograph including William Saliba after the defender's surprise absence from the one published this week.
metadata.content: Mikel Arteta says Arsenal plan to take another team photo including William Saliba after defender's omission | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Mikel Arteta says Arsenal plan to take another team photo including William Saliba after defender's omission William Saliba was left out of Arsenal's team photograph for the 2026/27 season earlier this week; Mikel Arteta explained it was taken because of commercial obligations despite defender's absence; club will retake image Nick Wright Football Features Writer @nicholaspwright Friday 16 October 2026 15:26, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Mikel Arteta explains why William Saliba wasn't included in the club's team picture Mikel Arteta says Arsenal will take a new team photograph including William Saliba after the defender's surprise absence from the one published this week. Arsenal supporters were left baffled by Saliba's omission from the official 2026/27 picture as the club revealed he was unavailable to attend due to a medical appointment. Saliba is yet to play this season because of a back injury but the 25-year-old remains a key player, having made 184 appearances for the club, which heightened the intrigue around his omission. "What happened was that we have tried to do that picture three times already and we had to cancel it last minute for different reasons," explained Arteta ahead of Arsenal's away trip to Nottingham Forest, live on Sky Sports on Sunday.
